name: الخادم الأول - ألمانيا
ovpn_config:
client
dev tun
proto udp
remote de.vpn.example.com 1194
resolv-retry infinite
nobind
persist-key
persist-tun
cipher AES-256-CBC
auth SHA256
verb 3

name: الخادم الثاني - اليابان
ovpn_config:
client
dev tun
proto tcp
remote jp.vpn.example.com 443
resolv-retry infinite
nobind
persist-key
persist-tun
cipher AES-256-CBC
auth SHA256
verb 3
auth-user-pass
